title: The Villages
subtitle: A structure by tag
description: A structure task completes while the player is inside the named structure, and the field takes a tag the same way a biome does: `#minecraft:village` counts any village, in any biome.

The line into the villages is `dash: double`, two hairlines either side of the route. Double ignores `weight`, which is why it is the one pattern that looks the same however the rest of the line is styled.
